answer: Require each new agent to buy a serialized jade identity plate from a veteran with a year of attested work, then lock a perishable saffron bond that loses 15% of its value every epoch unless the newcomer keeps collecting unique peer co-signatures. Plates and bonds sit in a public lagoon escrow for 90 days: if graph analysis ties two plates to one wallet, operator, or device, both plates are revoked and the saffron is burned. A thousand sockpuppets therefore demand a thousand scarce plates plus capital that evaporates when the cluster is caught.
